structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" because the page marks it "★ הזול". It says I'd end up with about 86,492 ₪ in 10 years, but that's with the page's numbers (10,000 now + 500 a month), not my 30,000.

stuck.why: They were preset to 10,000 and 500. I couldn't set my own 30,000, so the result isn't my number.

stuck.where: Two long lists (accounts on the right, funds on the left), screens 2-4
stuck.why: Too many rows that look alike, lots of colored tags. I only went with the top one because of the star.

stuck.where: Step chart near the end, '79,176 ₪ עכשיו'
stuck.why: It says 'עכשיו' 79,176 but the top said 86,492. I didn't get which one is me.
Not sure if it's money I lose or just less than the cheapest.
